Pokémon Psyduck Yellow

Opening corrections playtest · Prototype 011

Select your original USA HeartGold .nds file, then press the button to create your playable prototype.

Your original file stays on your device. It is never uploaded or changed.

Select your original file to begin.

Download prototype 011.nds

Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004–010 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Areas beyond Viridian remain blocked. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Oak walks to collect the two visible Pokédexes before giving them out. The last starter ball has its own message. Viridian’s old man lies in the center lane; invisible barriers close both side lanes and prevent walking around him. After the Pokédex, he stands, demonstrates catching, and walks aside. Blue’s full portrait appears in the touch-screen panel during his introduction and name confirmation. Eevee and its sparkles share Marill’s original resting position. Start a new game to check the intro. Route 2 and Viridian Forest remain closed for the next prototype. Evolution supplies remain in the player’s PC. Use a new game or a save made before parcel delivery to see the revised Oak scene.
